title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Master Cassette > Digitized 24-48 Sound Forge 7.0 > CD wave > Flac.16

ai_review.summary: Stellar show with high energy and flawless performances, captured on a crystal‑clear audience recording that sounds almost like a matrix.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the concert’s nonstop energy and near‑perfect set, highlighting standout renditions of “Crazy Fingers,” “Big River,” “High Time,” and others. The David Dyche audience tape is praised for its clean, clear mix that rivals a soundboard or matrix source, making it an ideal listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews emphasize both an exceptional performance and high‑quality recording; the limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, clear sound with minimal boominess or echo; audience bleed fades when music starts, vocals as clear as a soundboard; essentially a top‑notch matrix‑like capture.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently strong throughout; high‑energy start to finish with seamless transitions and no noticeable low points.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar blazing, inventive and unexpected lines throughout the entire show.
